name: Software Engineer
description: Designs and develops software applications and systems.
education_required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field

name: Data Scientist
description: Analyzes and interprets complex datasets to help organizations make informed decisions.
education_required: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Data Science or related field

name: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Analyzes and protects an organization's computer systems and networks from cyber threats.
education_required: Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity or IT

name: Doctor
description: Diagnoses and treats illnesses and injuries in patients.

name: Nurse
description: Provides and coordinates patient care in various healthcare settings.

name: Pharmacist
description: Dispenses medications and provides pharmaceutical care to patients.
education_required: Bachelor's or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree

name: Psychologist
description: Studies human behavior and mental processes, and provides therapy and counseling.
education_required: Master's or Doctoral Degree in Psychology and licensure

name: Accountant
description: Prepares and examines financial records and reports.
education_required: Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or related field

name: Financial Analyst
description: Analyzes financial data and provides insights for investment decisions.
education_required: Bachelor's Degree in Finance or Economics

name: Teacher
description: Educates students in specific subject areas and develops lesson plans.
education_required: Bachelor's Degree in Education or subject degree and teaching certification

name: Graphic Designer
description: Creates visual concepts and designs for various media and platforms.
education_required: Bachelor's Degree in Graphic Design or related field

name: Architect
description: Designs buildings and structures, ensuring they are safe, functional, and aesthetically pleasing.
education_required: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Architecture and licensure

name: Civil Engineer
description: Designs and supervises the construction of infrastructure projects like roads and bridges.
education_required: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering and licensure

name: Marketing Manager
description: Develops and implements marketing strategies to promote products or services.
education_required: Bachelor's Degree in Marketing or related field

name: Lawyer
description: Represents clients in legal matters and provides legal advice.
